title: Kaali-kääryjä (Finnish Cabbage Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with cabbage, meat, and rice.

ingredients.name: Chopped meat, bread crumbs, milk, eggs, onion, pepper, salt and butter mixed together

steps: Cook one cabbage and take off outside leaves
Remove tough stalk carefully
Boil rice until tender in a large quantity of water

Mix rice with the meat and chopped and fried small inside leaves

Place on a serving dish
